review.scope: docs/validation/installed-nine-pair-41397651278 only (read-only; no tests, no network, no edits)

findings.summary: The claim 'All three platform runners were assigned within five minutes of dispatch' cannot be checked against archived evidence.
findings.detail: Nothing in the archive records a dispatch timestamp. The local logs only show runner start times: ARM at 2026-11-02T06:05:51Z and macOS at 06:06:32Z. No local x64 job log was supplied, so the x64 runner start time is also unknown. Either cite the Actions run metadata or soften the sentence.

findings.summary: Two linux-x64 prerequisite files are not archived (peers.json.status.json and identity-ready/record.json).
findings.detail: This is consistent with the README, which only claims to preserve the installation and final cleanup reports. It is noted for completeness only.

readme_timings.arm failed identity_server: 265866240 = 0.265866240 s; correctly left out of the success table
readme_timings.clock: Stage clock is 'continuous+monotonic'; elapsed_ns is the continuous (suspend-inclusive) clock, so the README wording is accurate. Every row satisfies suspended_ns = max(0, elapsed - active) (ARM verify active > elapsed gives 0). All samples = 1, and the README disclaims percentiles and platform comparison.

evidence.failed_cells: All 9 cells: status failed, category required_evidence_invalid, metrics null, payload null, samples cold_status 0 and command 0; sample_count 0. The markdown table shows only '—'. The README says this is missing evidence, not zero latency or nine observed failures.
evidence.no_command_execution_claims: The rollup errors show every client-result and server-result as record_missing, plus identity_barrier_invalid. The README says the run 'failed before any remote command' and makes no claim that any command ran.
evidence.cleanup_meanings: Both Linux final cleanups have outcome complete with all 7 checks true. The installation records' 'cleanup: incomplete' is stage-local and is not presented as final. macOS cleanup is not-started, with checks null and duration_ns 0. The README explicitly says this does not prove cleanup of the compiler bootstrap.
evidence.source_and_archives: Both installation records give source_commit f609b6cc…, version 0.1.0-experimental.2, harness sha 9a694963…, and installer eac417b4…. Their archive and manifest sha256 values match rollup.targets for linux-arm64 (90e5c44e… / 457fd03d…) and linux-x64 (c409afda… / b7b87b1d…). Commit f609b6cc exists locally, and the docs/agent-spec.md link target exists.
evidence.arm_diagnostic: /tmp/marmish-a4-arm-job.log line 177, parsed fields only: category identity_init_failed, stage identity_server, frontend_category namespace_start_failed, reason nonzero_exit, returncode 125, timed_out false, output_limited false, signal null, cleanup complete. This matches the README.
evidence.mac_enospc: /tmp/marmish-full-41397651278-mac.log lines 133-137: 'cp: …/lib/rustlib/aarch64-apple-darwin/lib/lib*.rlib|rmeta: fcopyfile failed: No space left on device' during the standard-library copy. This matches the README. The runner path appears only in the local log, not in the archive.
evidence.secrets_and_paths: Grep of the archive for /home/, /Users/, runner/, _work, /tmp/, ghp_/gho_/github_pat, nsec1, PRIVATE KEY, token, secret and password found nothing. The only URLs are the public run/commit URLs and the two relay URLs.

dispositions.minor: Added closed public Actions run-summary.json with created_at, platform started_at and links, supporting within5minute scheduling claim.
dispositions.info: Intentionally preserve only stated installation/final-cleanup records; no other artifact preservation claim.
